title: SOMAscan proteomics and machine learning classify advanced liver fibrosis in NASH
summary: SOMAscan measured 1305 serum proteins in a discovery cohort of 113 NASH patients, with 97 proteins differing between advanced and early fibrosis. A machine learning approach built a four-protein model (AUROC 0.74, stage 0-1 versus 2-4) and a 12-protein classifier for advanced versus early fibrosis (AUROC 0.83). In two independent cohorts (n=71 and n=32) AUROC was 0.74-0.78, similar to or better than FIB-4, APRI and NAFLD fibrosis score models.
ai_technology: Machine learning classifiers on SOMAscan serum proteomics

evidence.tested: Discovery cohort (n=113) and two independent validation cohorts (n=71, n=32).
evidence.unknown: Small validation cohorts; exploratory; retrospective; modest AUROC; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning prioritized protein biomarkers and built fibrosis-stage classifiers.
